# Classifieds
[italic]Notices from readers, set as received. The Herald does not vouch for any of it. Dam and pit families advertise free.[/italic]
## Housing - [bold]BUNK TO LET[/bold] on the north bank, upwind of the ore yard. Fan works, roof does not leak in the storm season. Day shift tenant preferred. - [bold]WANTED[/bold], family quarters anywhere below the butte for a Cebrini turbine fitter, his wife and two children. Will repaint. - Official allocations are posted by the colony at [netlink="Seegson housing assignments" link="colony.seegson.net/housing"].
## Work - [bold]SPILLWAY CREW[/bold] wanted for the dry season inspection. Must climb, must not mind heights, must not mind the noise. - [bold]ORE HAULER DRIVERS[/bold] for the desert road south. Heavy vehicle licence and your own goggles. Night runs pay double for the heat. - [bold]CANTEEN COOK[/bold] needed at the pit head. Feed two hundred before dawn and keep the dust out of the rice.
## For Sale and Trade - [bold]DUST FILTERS[/bold] for respirators, washed and tested. Ten for twenty credits, or trade for coolant. - [bold]FISHING ROD[/bold], used on the reservoir. Anything it catches is yours to explain to the water board.
## Lost and Found - [bold]LOST[/bold]: an omamori charm in a red silk bag, stitched for safe work, somewhere between the shrine and the turbine hall. Its owner has been on the spillway without it all week. A bottle for its return.
## Notices - The river fork shrine holds its thunder prayers at the first storm of the season. Bring a cup of river water for the offering. The sake waits until after shift.
To place a notice, find the Herald's correspondent or leave a comment under any story on the front page.
